objective: Move HMAC verification into hydragrow-controller-core for pure, host-testable signed MQTT command verification.

acceptance.criterion: verify_signed_json_payload accepts valid HMAC signatures and returns parsed payload with signature.
verify_signed_json_payload rejects tampered payloads, wrong secrets, missing signatures, missing timestamps, missing nonces, or empty secrets.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests rejects_tampered_payload, rejects_wrong_secret, rejects_missing_signature, rejects_missing_ts, rejects_empty_secret

acceptance.criterion: All controller-core code passes cargo fmt --check, cargo check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, and unit test suite.
